title: 1.1 Continental Drift Theory
description: Pangaea, Laurasia, Gondwanaland, and the geological evidence behind Wegener’s theory. Hard level.

questions.question: Why is the fit of continental shelves stronger evidence than the fit of coastlines?
options: Shelves reveal the true submerged edges of continents
Shelves are affected by seasonal waves
Shelves are younger than coastlines
Shelves lie above sea level
questions.correctAnswer: Shelves reveal the true submerged edges of continents

questions.question: What does the presence of same-age rocks on both sides of the Atlantic support?
options: The Atlantic Ocean once covered all continents
Africa and South America were once contiguous
Mountain belts formed independently on each continent
Rock ages are identical worldwide
questions.correctAnswer: Africa and South America were once contiguous

questions.question: Which combination of evidence most strongly supported the existence of Pangaea?
options: Only the outlines of the continents
Only the distribution of deserts
Coastline fit, identical fossils, matching rock belts and paleoclimate
Only the age of oceanic crust
questions.correctAnswer: Coastline fit, identical fossils, matching rock belts and paleoclimate

questions.question: Why did the short timescale proposed by Wegener undermine his theory?
options: The rocks were too young to measure
The fossils were too small to study
The continents were too large to move
Scientists doubted that so much drift could happen in so short a time
questions.correctAnswer: Scientists doubted that so much drift could happen in so short a time

questions.question: What name is given to the shift from fixism to mobilism?
options: A paradigm change in viewing Earth
A return to ancient geology
A rejection of all fossils
A new theory of ocean tides
questions.correctAnswer: A paradigm change in viewing Earth

questions.question: How did the location of influential scientists weaken Wegener’s theory?
options: They all worked in South America
Most conclusive data came from the Southern Hemisphere
They rejected all field observations
They had access to no fossil data
questions.correctAnswer: Most conclusive data came from the Southern Hemisphere

questions.question: Mesosaurus was a small reptile found on both sides of the Atlantic. What does this imply?
options: The reptile crossed the open ocean repeatedly
The reptile evolved separately on each continent
The landmasses were connected so the reptile could disperse
The Atlantic Ocean was once a desert
questions.correctAnswer: The landmasses were connected so the reptile could disperse

questions.question: What do glacial deposits in now-tropical regions indicate?
options: Glaciers once formed at the equator only
Tropical regions have always been cold
The Earth axis never changes
Continents have moved into different climatic zones
questions.correctAnswer: Continents have moved into different climatic zones

questions.question: How is continental drift theory related to plate tectonics?
options: It introduced moving continents that plate tectonics later explained
It was replaced without leaving any legacy
It proved that continents are fixed
It described only ocean currents
questions.correctAnswer: It introduced moving continents that plate tectonics later explained

questions.question: Which achievement is considered Wegener’s most important legacy?
options: Discovering the mechanism of plate motion
Offering a paradigm change from fixism to mobilism
Mapping the ocean floor
Dating the age of Earth
questions.correctAnswer: Offering a paradigm change from fixism to mobilism
